verdict.rationale: The vendor documents custom GEMINI.md context files for tailoring behavior per project, and a /memory command, which maps directly to a project instructions file. A hands-on community report says the CLI consistently ignores both global and local GEMINI.md files even while reporting that the file is in use, which concretely contradicts whether the agent actually follows the conventions. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how GEMINI.md conventions are loaded and enforced, and independent corroboration that the agent reliably follows them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: Custom context files (GEMINI.md) to tailor behavior for your projects
